checkpoint_review: The Router's checkpoint verdicts are largely accurate but require slight adjustment on the 'toppings' checkpoint. The Router marked 'May be topped with sesame seeds...' as is_present: false. While the bagels are indeed plain, this checkpoint describes an optional feature ('May be'). Marking it 'false' implies a failure to meet a requirement, whereas it is simply an absence of an optional attribute. However, for strict auditing, marking it false is acceptable as the feature is not present. The Router correctly identified the 'interior crumb' checkpoint as untestable due to the whole state of the bagels. All geometric and material checkpoints (toroidal shape, gloss, color) were correctly verified as present.
